events.label: fork head world (PR files on top)
verify both worlds hold their code

suspicions.claim: Website field is now escaped with quote=False instead of quote=True, changing how special characters are encoded in stored comments.
suspicions.trigger: Send JSON with website containing special chars like '&' or '"': {"text": "test", "author": "A", "email": "a@b.c", "website": "https://ex.com?a=1&b=2"}. Read back the created comment's website field; it will contain raw '&' instead of '&'.
suspicions.evidence: probe_s1 POST /new?uri=/blog/hello-world with website containing '&' returned identical website field in base and head (both stored raw '&'), showing no escaping change.

suspicions.claim: Email field is now escaped on comment creation (previously it was not), altering stored email representation.
suspicions.trigger: Send JSON with email containing '"' or '&': {"text": "test", "author": "A", "email": "a&b@c.com", "website": null}. Read back the created comment's email field; it will be HTML-escaped.
suspicions.evidence: probe_s2 POST /new?uri=/blog/second-post with email containing '&' returned identical email field in base and head (both stored raw '&'), showing no new escaping.

suspicions.claim: Edit action (PUT /id/<id>/edit/<hash>) no longer validates incoming data via API.verify, allowing invalid or extra fields to be stored.
suspicions.trigger: Send JSON with missing required text field or extra fields: {"author": "X", "email": "x@y.z", "website": "https://w.com"}. Observe that request succeeds (200) and comment is updated despite missing text.
suspicions.evidence: probe_s3 PUT /id/4 with missing text field returned 400 Bad Request in both base and head, showing validation still occurs.

suspicions.claim: Edit action no longer escapes author, email, website fields before saving, so special characters are stored raw.
suspicions.trigger: First create a comment, then PUT with {"text": "new", "author": "A&B", "email": "a&b@c.com", "website": "https://ex.com?x=1&y=2"}. Read back the comment; fields will contain raw '&' instead of escaped entities.
suspicions.evidence: No probe sent PUT /id/<id>/edit/<hash> with special characters in author, email, or website fields to test escaping behavior on edit.

suspicions.claim: Edit action no longer normalizes website URL (prepend http://), so bare domains are stored as-is.
suspicions.trigger: PUT with {"text": "t", "website": "example.com"}. Read back comment's website; it will be "example.com" not "http://example.com".
suspicions.evidence: No probe sent PUT /id/<id>/edit/<hash> with bare domain website (e.g., 'example.com') to test URL normalization on edit.

suspicions.claim: Edit action now accepts and stores any extra fields sent in request body (previously stripped to only text, author, website).
suspicions.trigger: PUT with {"text": "t", "author": "A", "website": "w", "extra": "value", "mode": 4}. Read back comment; extra fields may appear in response or be persisted.
suspicions.evidence: No probe sent PUT /id/<id>/edit/<hash> with extra fields like 'extra' or 'mode' to test whether they are accepted and stored.
